mapper.select: SELECT A.airport_id AS airportId, A.iata_code AS iataCode, A.airport_name AS airportName, A.country AS country, A.timezone AS timezone, A.region_id AS regionId, R.region_name AS regionName, A.flight_type AS flightType, A.is_active AS isActive FROM AIRPORT A LEFT JOIN REGION R ON A.region_id = R.region_id ORDER BY A.airport_id ASC

SELECT airport_id AS airportId, iata_code AS iataCode, airport_name AS airportName, country, timezone, region_id AS regionId, flight_type AS flightType, is_active AS isActive FROM AIRPORT WHERE airport_id = #{airportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE AIRPORT SET iata_code = #{iataCode}, airport_name = #{airportName}, country = #{country}, timezone = #{timezone}, region_id = #{regionId}, flight_type = #{flightType}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE airport_id = #{airportId}
